name: Week of groceries
description: Rye bread, potatoes, milk, karelian pies and a bit of salmon on Fridays.

then.message: You have nothing to cook on. You live on dry rye bread for a day and the rest goes off. Something to cook on would help.
Your cupboard was already full. The extra goes off before you can eat it. A fridge would hold more.

else.message: You stock up on groceries and cook for the week.

name: Coffee & pulla
description: Strong coffee and a cardamom bun. The village runs on this.

else.message: Another cup. Your hands are shaking a little.

name: Pizza or kebab with fries
description: Kebab, pizza or makkaraperunat. Fills you up for the week, more or less.

then.message: You were already full. You eat it anyway and regret it all evening.

name: Scratch card
description: Scratch three matching symbols and dream.

name: Casual clothes
description: Jeans, a hoodie and a decent winter jacket.
wornOutText: Your casual clothes are worn to rags.

name: Smart clothes
description: A collared shirt and proper trousers. Shop-floor ready.
wornOutText: Your smart clothes are frayed beyond repair.

name: Business suit
description: Sharp enough for the bank and the Helsinki office.
wornOutText: Your business suit is shiny at the elbows. Time for a new one.

name: Work overalls & boots
description: Required for factory work.
wornOutText: Your work overalls are torn. The factory won't let you in like that.

name: Hot plate
description: A two-ring hot plate and a dented pot. Now you can cook your own groceries at home.

name: Bicycle
description: Gets you around the village faster. Lock it up.

name: Refrigerator
description: Store several weeks of food.

name: Coffee maker
description: Fresh coffee at home every morning. A good start to every week.

name: Television
description: Ice hockey and Finnish crime dramas. Evenings at home are better with one.

name: Computer
description: Helps with studying. Required for some courses.

name: Rag rug
description: A striped räsymatto, woven from somebody's old trousers. Makes a place feel like home. (Mom would never let you put it down at hers.)

name: Rubber plant
description: A big glossy rubber plant. Impossible to kill. You will try.

name: Lava lamp
description: Orange blobs rising and sinking forever. Hypnotic. Possibly a fire hazard.

name: Ryijy wall rug
description: A hand-knotted ryijy in autumn colours. Your grandmother would approve. Your landlord would not.

name: Flu vaccination
description: Protects against the seasonal flu for a while.
wornOutText: Your flu protection has run out.

name: Cottage deed
description: You own the red cottage by Punkanjoki. Property holds its value.

then.message: Since you don't live in the red cottage, a family from Helsinki rents it by the week. The rent goes straight into your bank account. They complain about the outhouse.

name: Beach kiosk lease
description: A long lease on the little kiosk at Ykslammi beach: coffee, ice cream, sausages and fishing worms. You would be your own boss, and quit any other job. Summers are busy. Winters are long.

then.message: You hand in your notice at your old job. From now on, you are the boss.

onBuy.message: You sign the lease and get a key on a wooden float. The beach kiosk is yours! Kalevi orders the first coffee and asks for credit.
